responsibility: Collects the public backend prototypes used across the RL78 port. It exposes the helper interfaces implemented mainly in rl78.cc for compare expansion, move splitting, prologue/epilogue generation, far/near address classification, legitimate address checks, reload/address legalization, peephole setup, symbol and label assembly output, section/common emission, and libcall construction, serving as the declaration boundary between the RL78 target headers, md-generated code, and C/C++ implementation files.
